In a 3-bidder second-price auction with independent private values, the dominant strategy is to bid your true value. Bidding your value wins exactly when the highest competing bid is below your value, yielding nonnegative profit equal to value minus that bid, and avoids winning at a loss. Underbidding risks missing profitable wins; overbidding risks negative profit. There’s only 1 round and no exploitable history, so no strategic deviation is beneficial. With value $24, bid $24.0.
